events.text:
**Evaluating flyer details**

I need to create a flyer that keeps the design simple and effective. It should include the title "The Old Foundry Arts Centre" at a font size of 19, with specific guidelines to keep it to six lines without any extra words. I want to mention that "Here’s a print-ready 4:5 SVG…" might not be accurate because the SVG I have isn't print-ready at 640, though it can scale. I’ll avoid unnecessary tools too!

Save the code below as **`open-studio-flyer.svg`**. It’s an exact **4:5** vector flyer, with the complete address preserved and no additional words in the design.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="640" height="800" viewBox="0 0 640 800">
  <rect width="640" height="800" fill="#F4EEDC"/>

  <g fill="#171714">
    <rect x="48" y="48" width="544" height="5"/>

    <text x="48" y="157"
          font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif"
          font-size="62" letter-spacing="-2">
      Printmakers'
    </text>
    <text x="48" y="225"
          font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif"
          font-size="62" letter-spacing="-2">
      Open Studio
    </text>

    <rect x="48" y="290" width="64" height="5"/>

    <g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"
       font-size="29" font-weight="bold">
      <text x="48" y="365">9 October 2027</text>
      <text x="48" y="409">11:00–17:00</text>
    </g>

    <rect x="48" y="481" width="544" height="1"/>

    <text font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"
          font-size="22" fill="#171714"
          xml:space="preserve"><tspan x="48" y="543">Unit 14B, Second Floor, </tspan><tspan x="48" y="577">The Old Foundry Arts Centre, </tspan><tspan x="48" y="611">127–129 St. John's Road, </tspan><tspan x="48" y="645">Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB</tspan></text>

    <rect x="48" y="747" width="544" height="5"/>
  </g>
</svg>
```
